blocks.text: Today, Multi-platinum selling singer, songwriter, producer and DJ Tinashe releases her highly anticipated 8th studio album, Popstar – Listen HERE. The genre spanning 16-track LP features production from Ricky Redd, Zach Sekoff, Fred Ball, Kingdom, Dave Hamelin, Machinedrum, Arca, Illangelo, Camper, kimj, nightfeelings, Couros, Casey Mattson, and Andrew Wells. Previously released singles, “Too Easy,” “Crash Out,” “Pillow Fight,” and “I’d Rather Be Alone” were all received to widespread critical praise.
